reading_notes: The last drum_fill row (t 4047.34) carries duration 37.64 s and 1370 hits. That is not a fill: it is the same hole beat_trust.json records in the grid, read by the fill detector as one enormous run. Treat it as 'the pulse stops here', not as a cue to cut on.

The only other solo_change in the window (4043.12) is a timbre step inside the same stem, which BASE weights at 0.60 for exactly this reason.

tail.measured_from: P:\Client Work\Ryan Devlin\2026-06-17_Zinc Bar\Audio\Reaper\Zinc Set 2 Reaper v4.wav
tail.method: ffmpeg -> 48 kHz mono float; 30 ms RMS at 10 ms hop. An attack is a >=8 dB step over the median of the 80-250 ms before it, landing at least 18 dB over the floor. Spectral flatness (geometric/arithmetic mean power) and centroid separate tonal music from broadband applause. Floor is the median RMS of 4080.0-4085.0 s, after the applause has died — the outro's own room tone.

ranking_rule: score = base + 0.20 per other event within 0.6 s (max 0.4) + 0.15 when the detector snapped it to a downbeat; base is the detector's confidence, prominence_db / 6 for an energy peak, and BASE[kind:signal] for a solo change. Identical to taurus_events.py so the two windows rank on one scale.
